data.subtitle: Welcome to The Sandwich Bar, the place in Amsterdam for a classic sandwich! With us, locals can still come in for a simple cheese sandwich.
data.title: The Sandwich Bar

children.text: The Sandwich Bar is the place in Amsterdam for a fresh, classic sandwich — made with high-quality, locally sourced ingredients. From a simple cheese to our famous spicy chicken, complemented by fresh juices and barista coffee from Bocca Amsterdam.
Come by for a quick lunch or a relaxed moment with friends. In a hurry? Call ahead and we'll have your sandwich ready.

The Sandwich Bar is here for you! Our dedicated team of professionals is happy to take care of your office meeting, corporate event, birthday, wedding, or any other occasion with delicious, freshly prepared sandwiches. We deliver our lunch catering throughout Amsterdam (and on request in surrounding areas).

At The Sandwich Bar we believe in quality and variety. Our menu offers a wide range of flavours and ingredients, and we are happy to accommodate dietary requirements — including gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan options.

data.label: Catering
data.title: Looking for the best sandwich catering in Amsterdam?

faqItems.answer:
We offer a wide range of freshly made sandwiches, from a classic beef carpaccio baguette to our well-known spicy chicken sandwich. We also have vegetarian and vegan options available. Our bread selection includes white baguettes, brown spelt buns, and gluten-free bread.
In addition to our sandwiches, we also offer one salad, one yogurt bowl (also available vegan), cold-pressed juices, croissants, sweet snacks, and soft drinks.
faqItems.question: What kind of sandwiches do you offer?

faqItems.answer: Yes, we provide catering for businesses, events, and meetings in and around Amsterdam. You can easily place your order through our catering platform: https://catering.thesandwichbar.nl.
faqItems.question: Do you also offer catering?

faqItems.answer: You can easily place a catering order through our catering platform: https://catering.thesandwichbar.nl
faqItems.question: How can I place a catering order?

faqItems.answer: Absolutely! We are happy to accommodate dietary requirements such as vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, or allergies. Please indicate this when placing your order under “comments“ section.
faqItems.question: Can you accommodate dietary requirements?

faqItems.answer: We deliver our sandwiches and catering orders in Amsterdam. Delivery costs may vary depending on the location. Delivery to areas around Amsterdam is also possible upon request. Please send us an email at orders@thesandwichbar.nl or feel free to call our catering mobile number to discuss the options.
faqItems.question: Where do you deliver?

faqItems.answer: Our opening hours vary by day. Please check our website and locations for the most up-to-date times.
faqItems.question: What are your opening hours?

faqItems.answer: Cancellations must be made by email at least 24 hours in advance
faqItems.question: Can I still cancel my catering order?

faqItems.answer: Unfortunately, we do not cut our sandwiches in half. We prepare all of our sandwiches according to a standard procedure, which allows us to handle multiple orders at the same time efficiently and consistently. Therefore, unfortunately, we are unable to make individual exceptions to this.
